changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0032. Add the user-type catalog for platform, personal, business, and fitness-staff kinds. A user type names a kind of person and optionally points at the existing role that authorizes them. It does not create a second account. Index review: PK_UserTypes identifies a type; FK_UserTypes_Roles and IX_UserTypes_RoleId support the optional role link, filtered to rows that have a role; UX_UserTypes_Code identifies an active type by its stable code. Performance note: the catalog stays small, and both secondary indexes are filtered.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE app.UserTypes ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Code NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, Name NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, Description NVARCHAR(256) NULL, Category NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, RoleId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, SortOrder INT NOT NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_UserTypes PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_UserTypes_Roles FOREIGN KEY (RoleId) REFERENCES app.Roles (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_UserTypes_Category CHECK (Category IN (N'Platform', N'Personal', N'Business', N'Staff')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_UserTypes_Code ON app.UserTypes (Code) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_UserTypes_RoleId ON app.UserTypes (RoleId) WHERE RoleId IS NOT NULL;
INSERT INTO app.UserTypes (Id, Code, Name, Description, Category, RoleId, SortOrder, IsActive, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt) SELECT CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, v.Id), v.Code, v.Name, v.Description, v.Category, r.Id, v.SortOrder, 1, SYSUTCDATETIME(), SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM (VALUES ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555001', N'NORMAL_USER', N'Normal user', N'A person who registered on the platform.', N'Personal', N'PersonalMember', 10), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555002', N'SUPER_ADMIN', N'Super admin', N'Platform operator. Not assigned during normal registration.', N'Platform', N'SuperAdmin', 20), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555003', N'BUSINESS_OWNER', N'Business tenant', N'The person who owns a gym or other fitness business.', N'Business', N'GymOwner', 30), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555004', N'BUSINESS_USER', N'Business tenant user', N'A member added to a business workspace.', N'Business', N'Member', 40), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555005', N'COACH', N'Coach', N'Leads workouts and training sessions.', N'Staff', N'Trainer', 50), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555006', N'RECEPTIONIST', N'Receptionist', N'Handles the front desk, check-in, and membership desk.', N'Staff', N'Receptionist', 60), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555007', N'MANAGER', N'Manager', N'Runs day-to-day business operations.', N'Staff', N'GymManager', 70), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555008', N'GROUP_INSTRUCTOR', N'Group instructor', N'Leads group classes such as yoga, pilates, or studio sessions.', N'Staff', NULL, 80), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555009', N'NUTRITIONIST', N'Nutritionist', N'Guides nutrition for members.', N'Staff', NULL, 90), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555500A', N'PHYSIOTHERAPIST', N'Physiotherapist', N'Supports recovery and movement in a physio or fitness business.', N'Staff', NULL, 100), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555500B', N'MEMBERSHIP_ADVISOR', N'Membership advisor', N'Sells and renews memberships.', N'Staff', NULL, 110), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555500C', N'HOUSEKEEPING', N'Housekeeping', N'Keeps the facility clean.', N'Staff', NULL, 120), ('55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555500D', N'MAINTENANCE', N'Maintenance', N'Maintains equipment and the facility.', N'Staff', NULL, 130) ) AS v(Id, Code, Name, Description, Category, RoleName, SortOrder) LEFT JOIN app.Roles r ON r.Name = v.RoleName AND r.DeletedAt IS NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.UserTypes existing WHERE existing.Code = v.Code AND existing.DeletedAt IS NULL);
